prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

tool_calls.name: codemode
tool_calls.input:
const r = await Promise.all([
 tools.calendar({command:"list",from:"2026-11-10T00:00:00-08:00",to:"2026-11-11T00:00:00-08:00"}),
 tools.mail({command:"search",query:"budget",from:"Dana",limit:10}),
 tools.drive({command:"search",query:"budget spreadsheet",limit:10})
]); for (const x of r) text(x)
